title: Tidal Physics
description: Gravity pulls harder on your near side than your far side. Near a small black hole the difference tears anything apart lengthwise, spaghettification.

puzzle.goal: A body of length L hangs head-down at distance r from a mass M. Write the difference a between the pull on its two ends, with G.
puzzle.name: Spaghettification
puzzle.ask: Find a in g for a 2 m body 100 km from a 10-solar-mass black hole: M = @{M} kg, L = 2, r = 1e5, G = 6.674e-11.
puzzle.method: Differentiate GM/r² with respect to r and multiply by L.
